caseNameFull: M. Frank Andrews v. United States
summary: Error to the District Court of the United States for the Western District of South Carolina.
attorneys: Mr. Hugh H. Obear, Mr. Charles A. Douglas, Mr. Richard A. Ford and Mr. H. C. Miller for plaintiff in error., Mr. Solicitor General Beck, Mr. Assistant Attorney General Crim and Mr. Blackburn Esterline, Assistant to the Solicitor General, for the United States. •

opinions.text: Judgment reversed, upon confession of error by the defendant in error, on motion of Mr. Hugh H. Obear for pis intiff in error, with consent thereto by Mr. Solicitor General Beck for the United States.
